scenes.location: center nurses station, fixed residential-left and detox-right geography
scenes.camera_axis: viewer-facing side of the nurses station without crossing the line
scenes.wardrobe_lock: orca, rainbow, puffer and tang nurses retain their canonical blue scrubs and ID badges

beats.prompt: The nurses notice the rhythm and exchange amused looks while continuing their work; the camera makes a gentle lateral move.

action_arc.setup: the orca checks the monitor while the puffer notices the beat
action_arc.development: the puffer tests a small dance step and the orca answers with a deadpan nod
action_arc.payoff: both land on a shared reaction as the camera reaches the workstation

beats.prompt: Two nurses begin a playful synchronized step in the background while the foreground nurse finishes checking the monitor.

action_arc.setup: the tang joins the puffer's step without abandoning the workstation
action_arc.development: they build a readable synchronized phrase with distinct poses
action_arc.payoff: they open a lane for the lead's entrance and point toward camera

beats.prompt: The female lead enters with the microphone and performs energetically as the background dance grows into a coordinated flash mob.

action_arc.setup: the rainbow lead enters and establishes the vocal phrase
action_arc.development: the background pair answers each lyric with coordinated comic gestures
action_arc.payoff: the trio completes a broad turn and faces front on the beat

beats.prompt: The full female nurse ensemble completes a joyful final dance phrase, then lands together in a clean readable pose.

action_arc.setup: the ensemble expands into the full station while the orca keeps working
action_arc.development: the three performers complete the largest synchronized dance phrase
action_arc.payoff: everyone lands in a clean joyful final pose while the silent orca gives one approving nod
